subject.title: [Feature]: Add an optional result-return mode for /hooks/agent

question: Should OpenClaw add a synchronous result-return mode to `POST /hooks/agent`, and if yes should the permanent API follow the linked PR's `waitForResult` and `announceToMain` shape?
rationale: The missing behavior is source-proven, but it changes a stable Gateway HTTP surface and security-sensitive hook behavior, so automation cannot safely choose the product and security contract.

options.title: Adopt the linked PR shape after hardening
options.body: Use `waitForResult` plus `announceToMain` if maintainers accept the synchronous hook contract, with output, timeout, replay, and error-disclosure concerns resolved before merge.

options.title: Choose a different sync contract
options.body: Ask the contributor to reshape the implementation around a dedicated sync endpoint or result URL if that boundary is safer or clearer than extending the current endpoint.

options.title: Decline the core API for now
options.body: Keep the documented async `/hooks/agent` plus `sessions_history` workaround and close the linked implementation if maintainers decide this should not be a core Gateway surface.

recommendation.title: Adopt the linked PR shape after hardening
recommendation.body: Use `waitForResult` plus `announceToMain` if maintainers accept the synchronous hook contract, with output, timeout, replay, and error-disclosure concerns resolved before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The sampled history shows the most work on the central hook files and this decision spans the Gateway API/product boundary rather than a narrow defect.
